new_articles.title: SK Hynix puts US IPO of chip unit Solidigm on hold after Seoul authorities raise concerns
new_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'SK Hynix puts US IPO of chip unit Solidigm on hold after Seoul authorities raise concerns'이다. The South Korean chip giant said it plans to continue to explore ways to fund Solidigm’s expansion. SK Hynix will review future funding plans instead; the move may affect US chip policy talks and reflects wider fears over AI stock valuations and dilution It could also have funded share cancellations and buybacks, SK Hynix said in a statement 4% higher, outperforming a flat broader market as worries that a Solidigm IPO could dilute SK Hynix shareholders’ interests abated It was not immediately clear how the decision would be received by the Trump administration, which has put pressure on foreign chipmakers to build new facilities in the US and which has been holding discussions with SK Hynix On one hand, SK Hynix’s decision to hit the pause button on the Solidigm IPO reflects a sharp pullback in sentiment towards AI-sector stocks as investors fret over the implications of rising borrowing costs for the debt-heavy sector. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

new_articles.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 review – a thrilling airport novel of a game
new_articles.summary: Korean Air 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 review – a thrilling airport novel of a game'이다. Activision; PC, PS5, Switch 2, Xbox From parkour over Manhattan rooftops and car chases in Paris to the climactic battle at a North Korean air base, the developers have thrown absolutely everything at the game And so we return perhaps one final time to Call of Duty’s Modern Warfare strand, with stories, “ripped from the newspaper headlines”, featuring shady terror organisations, nefarious rogue states and the brutally capable, monosyllabic war fighters who stand between us and Armageddon. Last year’s Black Ops 7 instalment was a sales disappointment for Activision, and that has no doubt put extra pressure on Infinity Ward, the studio leading Modern Warfare 4 development. Fortunately, this developer – like series heroes Price, Gaz and Ghost – seems to thrive on pressure. As you may have read , this year’s campaign is based around a fictitious North Korean ruling family that has seized an opportunity to invade its southern neighbour. Amid the chaos, a small group of Korean and American marines must help lead the fightback, while in the shadows, SAS hard man John Price makes an unlikely new comrade in his own morally ambiguous quest to put the world to rights. Mads Mikkelsen pops up as evil mastermind The Archer, but like Kiernan Shipka in Black Ops 7 he’s rather wasted, with very little screen time.
